current49_cause.finding: One interior row loses a flank anchor: conservative vehicle cover leaves exactly2 visible road samples; baseline requires3 horizontally. Its neighboring rows satisfy the original rule. The unrepresented row creates a road-union boundary through the current hull.
current49_cause.current_visible_evidence: The same2 columns over3 rows provide6 current raw road-colour samples outside the conservative cover. The opposite flank and both neighboring original anchors are available.
current49_cause.occluded_evidence: The center of the gap is opaque, not directly observed asphalt. Any added gap support has the SAME conditional connected-corridor status as baseline; it is not an unconditional observation or safety certificate.
current49_cause.existing_registered_history: All7 frame registrations were rejected for insufficient reliable features; no past road mask was substituted.

external_diagnostic.scope: Existing saved map only, after the observation-only diagnosis. No new world and no true-state/map Agent input. It separates this observed geometry failure from a demonstrated actual boundary collision, without proving actual future safety.

visibility_vs_hidden_truth.negative_scope: Pixel-observability counterexample only; not certified as a valid HAIC tile chain.
visibility_vs_hidden_truth.conclusion: Raw plateau availability and hidden corridor validity are separate tests. A real-contract same-ribbon/topology inclusion bound remains unproved; this example proves neither universal impossibility nor a safe fill rule.

public_counterexamples.scope: Public synthetic fixed-width straight-road and material/anchor veto cases. The hidden-hole toy is explicitly NOT proved to be a valid HAIC track and is not a universal impossibility argument.

minimal_rule.activation: Only one missing INTERIOR row between two ORIGINAL validated rows; exactly2 visible samples on one flank and original>=3 on the other. Recovered rows never become anchors, and existing continuation/endpoint rows are not reinterpreted.
minimal_rule.support: The SAME2 columns over3 current rows must all be raw road-colour asphalt, outside cover, outside grass/object masks, and within the existing7.1gray range.
minimal_rule.geometry: Retain all existing gap/material/obstacle/paint guards. Both new flank intervals must contain the FROZEN original fitted lines; its width interval must intersect the original common width interval. No original direction/width refit or endpoint extension.
minimal_rule.assumption: Baseline-relative repair under the existing local connected-road hypothesis. It adds5 occluded support pixels in this cached case; their road status is inferred conditionally, not directly seen.
minimal_rule.thresholds: No reduction of the original3-sample flank threshold; the new isolated-row alternative uses6 actual samples and original neighbors. No force, footprint, width, paint or horizon threshold is relaxed.
minimal_rule.rejected_stronger_probe: A proposed per-sample3x3flat requirement failed because its stencil crosses the visible road edge. That is stronger than the original RAW3-sample rule and was not implemented. The public comparison keeps this distinction explicit.

cached_causal_gate.reference_change: Current support reconnects the observed prefix and makes the existing current width proposal eligible. Reference/curvature/speed/progress are recomputed by unchanged formulas. No retained reference or higher-speed/admission-based choice is introduced.

static_review.scope: New helper and integration only; original validated base rows, nonrecursive recovery, current six-sample guards, opposite original flank, frozen line and common width intersection, initialization variable lifecycle.
static_review.CPU: Unmetered static read, covered by phase15s administrative allowance.

actual_final_source_reset.comparison_scope: One DEV prefix, not global performance/safety validation or submission readiness.

new_blocker.interpretation: The new observation cannot establish the unchanged current footprint margin. The narrow alternative does not activate; no guard was widened. This does not by itself establish an actual physical collision.
new_blocker.next_step: Separately diagnose the next current road/occlusion support failure before any new repair.
new_blocker.response: Stop the DEV run when no candidate passes. This is fail-closed evaluation termination, not a proved emergency controller.

exact_failure_replay.inputs: Full pre-act reset-local memory and pixels; persistent counter restored and replay delta charged separately; no true state read.

preservation.private_artifacts: Actual-case coordinates, images, state/action traces, saved map and approvals remain outside the repository.

reproduction: Final source was packaged, reset-tested and failed identically in a full-Agent pixels/own-memory replay. Private case checkpoints remain private.
